ngaap.guidance: 2022 guidance initiated 31-Jan-2022: Revenue $17.3 billion - $17.7 billion. Organic revenue growth up 1.0% - 3.0%. Segment operating margin 16.00% - 16.25% (new metric, on the 2022 three-segment basis with CAS pension cost in segments). L3Harris GAAP net income margin 12.00% - 12.25%. L3Harris adjusted EBIT margin 19.00% - 19.25%. GAAP EPS $10.75 - $11.05. Non-GAAP EPS $13.35 - $13.65. Operating cash flow $2.4 billion - $2.5 billion. Adjusted free cash flow $2.15 billion - $2.25 billion. R&D tax impact $600 million - $700 million (assumes the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act requirement to capitalize and amortize R&D expenditures over five years from 1-Jan-2022 is not modified, repealed or deferred). Share repurchases ~$1.5 billion. Guidance tables (2022): GAAP EPS $10.75 - $11.05; L3Harris Merger integration costs ~0.18; amortization of acquisition-related intangibles ~3.12; NCI portion ~(0.02); total pre-tax ~3.28; income taxes ~(0.68); after-tax ~2.60; non-GAAP EPS $13.35 - $13.65. Revenue midpoint $17.5 billion; net income $2,100 - $2,145; net interest expense ~265; income taxes ~320; integration costs ~35; amortization ~605; total adjustments ~1,225. Cash flow: operating cash flow $2,405 - $2,505; additions to PP&E ~(330); free cash flow 2,075 - 2,175; cash used for integration ~75; adjusted FCF $2,150 - $2,250.
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP EPS = income from continuing operations per diluted share attributable to common shareholders, excluding L3Harris Merger integration costs, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (all acquired intangibles), business divestiture-related gains/losses and other divestiture-related expenses, impairment of goodwill and other assets / investment and asset impairment charges, restructuring and other items, net of the noncontrolling-interest portion and of income taxes. Adjusted EBIT = net income + discontinued operations + net interest expense + income taxes + the same pre-tax items (it INCLUDES non-operating income / non-service FAS pension income). Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow - net additions of PP&E + cash used for L3Harris Merger integration costs + net cash paid for income taxes associated with business divestitures. Columnar reconciliation (Table 8A): only the total per-share adjustment (0.84, incl. NCI portion) is printed; dollar adjustments by line are in item_amounts (pre-tax 181 = 184 unallocated items - 3 non-operating income; tax (16); non-GAAP income from continuing operations 649; non-GAAP pre-tax income 769; 196.8 million diluted shares). FCF bridge values are the QUARTER column. From 2022 the company changes its segment measure (CAS pension cost in segments, FAS/CAS operating adjustment) but keeps the same non-GAAP EPS definition in the 2022 guidance (integration costs and amortization of acquisition-related intangibles).
